definitions.aggregation: Cross-section and cumulative ratios divide sums across each 20-seed cohort. Paired C-minus-reference differences first compare within each seed; summary statistics give each comparable pair equal weight. Undefined ratios are excluded and counted via observed.
definitions.arms: A is the archived reference ordering. B prioritizes resident relief. C uses the reference ordering with the public-farm harvest allocation. C-minus-B therefore compares two complete policy paths.
definitions.cases: At year 200 an increase in cumulative unmet share represents a larger fraction of resident need left unmet. Examples give the largest increase, largest decrease and first exact tie; null means no observed example. Country cases evaluate only years 151–200.
definitions.days: 365 × closing public food / annual resident food need using uniform daily demand. Zero need has no day estimate. Stock days measure coverage, not delivered meals.
definitions.labor: Public and private farm workers and effective farm slots partition agriculture. Physical farmland is counted separately. Soil, equipment and climate means weight by active farm workers. A paired allocation change does not isolate the same-state opportunity cost.
definitions.persistence: A 151–200 window maintains a one-day floor if 365 × closing food ≥ need at all 50 observations with positive need each year. The stricter count also requires closing stock in 200 ≥ opening stock in 151. Both describe only the observed interval.
definitions.stock_counts: All 50 year-end stocks contribute to positive_years. Only positive-demand observations contribute to one_day_years. A world and its countries are checked separately.
definitions.taxable_surplus: At levy time compare private stock with the protected floor. Among private harvesters means region-years with positive private harvest, independent of the public share. The share is weighted by region-year appearances.
definitions.time: Each checkpoint gives that single year and cumulative flows through that year. Labor and land slots accumulated across years are worker-years and slot-years.
definitions.turns: Five consecutive true years establish onset; five false years after onset establish recovery. First onset may predate year 51. For transitions confirmed in 51–200, positive/negative signed values date the first year of the onset/recovery run. Later brief fluctuations are ignored. A final unconfirmed transition is right-censored.
